JHN.19.16-16.text: Pilate hands Jesus over to be crucified

JHN.19.17-18.text: Jesus is crucified at Golgotha with two others

JHN.19.19-20.text: Pilate puts a sign on the cross in three languages

JHN.19.21-22.text: Pilate refuses the priests’ request to change the sign

JHN.19.23-24.text: The soldiers divide Jesus’ clothes and cast lots

JHN.19.25-27.text: Jesus asks his disciple to care for his mother

JHN.19.31-33.text: Soldiers do not break Jesus’ legs because he is dead

JHN.19.34-35.text: A soldier pierces Jesus’ side with a spear

JHN.19.36-37.text: These events fulfill two sayings in Scripture

check.why: “These events” is not clear when the title is read alone in a list.
check.suggestion: What happened to Jesus fulfills Scripture

JHN.19.38-39.text: Joseph and Nicodemus take Jesus’ body from the cross

check.why: Joseph removed Jesus’ body, while Nicodemus brought spices.
check.suggestion: Joseph takes Jesus’ body, and Nicodemus brings spices

JHN.19.40-42.text: Joseph and Nicodemus bury Jesus in a new tomb

JHN.20.1-2.text: Mary Magdalene finds the tomb open and tells Peter

JHN.20.3-5.text: Peter and the other disciple run to the tomb

JHN.20.6-7.text: Peter goes into the tomb and sees the linen cloths

JHN.20.8-9.text: The other disciple goes in, sees, and believes

JHN.20.10-10.text: The two disciples go back home

JHN.20.11-13.text: Mary weeps and sees two angels in the tomb

JHN.20.14-15.text: Mary sees Jesus but thinks he is the gardener

JHN.20.16-18.text: Jesus calls Mary’s name, and she tells the disciples

JHN.20.19-20.text: Jesus appears to the disciples behind locked doors

JHN.20.21-23.text: Jesus sends the disciples and gives the Holy Spirit

JHN.20.24-25.text: Thomas will not believe until he sees Jesus’ wounds

JHN.20.26-27.text: Jesus tells Thomas to touch his hands and side

JHN.20.28-29.text: Thomas calls Jesus his Lord and God

JHN.21.1-3.text: Seven disciples go fishing but catch nothing

JHN.21.4-6.text: Jesus tells the disciples where to cast the net

JHN.21.7-9.text: Peter jumps into the sea when he knows it is Jesus

JHN.21.10-11.text: Peter pulls the net with 153 large fish ashore

JHN.21.12-14.text: Jesus gives the disciples breakfast of bread and fish

JHN.21.15-16.text: Jesus asks Peter twice if he loves him

JHN.21.17-18.text: Jesus asks a third time and tells of Peter’s death

JHN.21.19-19.text: Jesus tells Peter to follow him

JHN.21.20-21.text: Peter asks Jesus what will happen to the other disciple

JHN.21.22-23.text: Jesus corrects a rumor that the disciple will not die

check.why: Jesus did not correct the rumor; his words gave rise to it, and the writer explains what he meant.
check.suggestion: Jesus answers Peter about the other disciple

JHN.21.24-25.text: The writer’s testimony is true; Jesus did much more
